outcome_rule.unit: unique visible (clip, frame_index, role) with a baseline match
outcome_rule.survived: an unchanged baseline candidate group still matches the fixed hand line
outcome_rule.moved: the baseline group has the same member segment identities in the enlarged grouping but its refit candidate no longer matches
outcome_rule.absorbed: a baseline group's segment identities are contained in an enlarged group with additional segment identities
outcome_rule.fragmented: the baseline group's segment identities occur across two or more enlarged groups

proposal.name: immutable baseline groups plus supplementary-only groups
proposal.method: Group the frozen baseline proposal set with candidate_line_group_details(..., 5.0, 10.0) and retain each resulting CandidateLineGroup and fit unchanged. Determine added proposals by G132's existing baseline-first one-pixel endpoint deduplication. Group only those added proposals with the same candidate_line_group_details(..., 5.0, 10.0) call, then append those supplementary groups after the immutable baseline groups. No baseline group is refit, merged, replaced, or re-ordered, and no threshold, detector, calibration, correspondence, label, manifest, or coordinate-contract value changes.
proposal.stability_claim_to_test: Every baseline match survives because baseline candidates are preserved verbatim; recall and paired precision remain measured rather than assumed.

measurement_plan.before: baseline and original G132 single-pass enlarged grouping
measurement_plan.union_follow_on: If and only if survival is 25/25, report the enlarged-set result from the stable grouping.
measurement_plan.renders: side-by-side baseline versus original enlarged grouping for at least five affected lines, selected from all non-SURVIVED baseline-match outcomes
